verdict.rationale: Productboard's Webhooks API can trigger real-time notifications when feature status data changes, and the REST API lets feedback be linked to customers/companies, which together could be used to build a customer-notification workflow. However, there is no evidence of a built-in, PM-facing feature that automatically emails/notifies customers when their specific requested feature's status changes — it would require custom integration work. Missing for 10: a native customer-notification/status-update feature, documentation of automatic customer emails tied to feedback status, and independent/hands-on confirmation this workflow is used in practice.
